role: Summer 2027: AI Science Intern
jd:
Overview

To qualify for US internships, you must be currently enrolled in a degree-seeking program with an expected graduation date after the internship/co-op ends. If you do not meet this requirement, we invite you to explore other opportunities available on our careers website.

Intuit internships are 12 weeks throughout the summer. We have fixed start and end dates that are designed to work with various universities’ academic calendars.



- Cohort 1: Monday, May 17 - Friday, August 6, 2027 (12 weeks)
- Cohort 2: Monday, June 14 - Friday September 3, 2027 (12 weeks)

About Our Emerging Talent Program

Intuit invests in Emerging Talent because fresh perspectives strengthen our products and teams. The program is backed by a culture that values curiosity and collaboration, and you'll be supported by dedicated managers and mentors who are invested in your growth. As an intern or co-op, you'll work on meaningful projects with business impact, many centered on AI and emerging technologies, and contribute to driving decisions. You'll build skills through function-specific learning opportunities, connect with a global community of interns and co-ops through dedicated programming and social events, and get exposure to senior leadership and cross-functional work across Intuit's product ecosystem. Learn more about our Intern and Co-op Program here.

As an AI Scientist Intern at Intuit, you won't just be observing; you'll be on the front lines. You'll work side-by-side with our world-class AI Scientists, Researchers and Machine Learning Engineers, collaborating with Data Analysts, Software Engineers, and Product Managers. This is your chance to uncover critical insights and develop powerful machine learning models that directly understand and enhance customer experiences across Intuit's products.

Previous AI Scientist Interns have worked on projects such as improving customer experiences by applying adversarial deep learning to ranking algorithms and assessing call quality using transcript data; innovating with NLP and deep learning to link form lines to documentation, build temporal recommendation models, and develop unsupervised knowledge acquisition for Q&A systems; forecasting and prediction through transaction time series forecasting, real-time churn prediction, and predicting cognitive biases with financial data; and enhancing model training by exploring active learning for event labels and creating customer intent classifiers for digital assistants.

Responsibilities



- Gather, clean, and explore large, real-world datasets to uncover patterns and prepare them for modeling, including your own data wrangling and ETL.
- Build, train, and evaluate machine learning and deep learning models using techniques such as classification, regression, clustering, and neural networks.
- Engineer and refine features from raw data, developing intuition for what drives model performance.
- Design and run experiments (e.g., A/B tests), perform statistical analysis, and communicate the impact of your models to peers and leaders.
- Dive into current AI/ML research and methodologies, including generative AI and LLMs, to inform new solutions and stay ahead of the curve.
- Partner with AI Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Analysts, Software Engineers, and Product Managers to translate insights into product impact.
- Develop proofs-of-concept for innovative, AI-driven features or solutions.
- Create clear documentation of your research, model architectures, code, and experimental results for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Qualifications



- Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science or a related technical field. Alternatively, a Bachelor's or Master's program with prior relevant experience and a graduation date after the internship ends.
- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis for the duration of the internship.
- Ability to work in a hybrid environment at an Intuit office location determined by your team and role (relocation stipend provided).
- Familiarity with core machine learning techniques (regression, classification, clustering, optimization) and their mathematical foundations.
- Ability to explore, discover, and import data from multiple sources and make it machine-learning ready.
- Strong programming skills in Python; SQL proficiency.
- Curiosity about generative AI and large language models, and interest in applying AI tools to accelerate your own work.
- Excellent communication skills and a learning mindset.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: $42.69 - $86.68 /hr.

The Expected Base Pay Range For This Position Is

Mountain View $50.5 - $89.5

New York $49.5- $86.5

San Diego, CA $45- $82

jd:
Who We Are

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

What We Are Looking For

We're searching for Summer 2027 Data & ML Platform Engineering Intern. You'll join one of the teams building the infrastructure that makes Aurora's ML work at scale — data pipelines, ML platforms, labeling and data-engine systems, distributed compute, and the cloud tooling that turns raw sensor and behavioral data into model-ready datasets.

In this role you will



- Build and maintain data pipelines and workflow automation that turn raw fleet and sensor data into model-ready datasets
- Design or extend ML platform tooling (labeling systems, data engines, distributed compute) used across autonomy teams
- Use cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) to scale data ingestion, storage, and processing workloads

Desired Qualifications



- Experience with parallel execution / distributed processing frameworks (e.g. Spark, Ray, Dask)

Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom.

jd:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Visa will accept applications for this role until at least 11-06-2026

Job Description

Visa’s Internship Program provides an immersive, 12-week journey where you’ll work on impactful projects that drive Visa’s mission forward. As a Visa intern, you’ll build valuable connections across the organization, sharpen your communication and business acumen, and gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, global environment.

Throughout the program, you’ll have exclusive access to interactive workshops and learning sessions designed to deepen your expertise, expand your industry knowledge, and elevate your professional skillset. You won’t just be learning, you’ll be contributing, collaborating, and innovating every step of the way. In addition to professional development, you’ll enjoy a variety of intern social events that foster community, connection, and fun throughout the summer

The experience culminates in an exciting final presentation, where you’ll showcase your project achievements, share key insights, and present your recommendations to Visa’s leaders and stakeholders. This is your chance to demonstrate your business impact, highlight your personal growth, and align your work with Visa’s vision for the future.

Data is central to Visa’s strategy, innovation, and long-term growth. Across the company, we are focused on using data responsibly to create value for consumers, businesses, clients, partners, and communities around the world. Guided by Visa’s Data Values and our commitment to trusted, responsible data use, Visa is continuing to expand its data capabilities, strengthen its data-driven products, and identify new ways to support the future of digital payments.

Visa’s Data & AI Team, led by the Chief Data Officer, plays a key role in advancing this work across the enterprise. The team owns strategic initiatives related to data business strategy, product development, investment priorities, governance, policy, and marketplace execution. In close partnership with the Chief Privacy Officer, Technology teams, business units, regional teams, and the broader Visa data community, the Data & AI Team drives high-impact efforts shaping how Visa uses data to drive innovation and deliver trusted solutions at scale

The Data & AI Team is seeking Data Science interns to help develop insights, analytical frameworks, and models that inform business strategy, product development, operational performance, and client outcomes. As an intern, you will work with cross-functional partners across data science, product, technology, data & analytics, privacy, governance, and regional and global business teams to apply data-driven approaches to complex business challenges.

In this role, you may support activities such as exploratory data analysis, feature development, statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, forecasting, performance measurement, and decision modeling. You will help translate data into actionable insights, evaluate opportunities and tradeoffs, and support model-informed decisions that improve products, platforms, customer experiences, and business outcomes.

This internship offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in data science and decision science within a global company. You will contribute to meaningful analytical and modeling initiatives, strengthen your technical and business skills, and help advance responsible, data-driven innovation across Visa’s global business.

All Visa roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Potential Responsibilities Include



- Analyze large-scale datasets using modern, cloud-based data and analytics platforms, applying tools such as Claude Code, Python, SQL, Spark, and other cloud-native technologies.
- Leverage governed data assets and reusable pipelines to conduct exploratory analysis, develop features, evaluate trends, and generate insights for business, product, client, and operational use cases.
- Apply data science and decision science methods, including statistical analysis, machine learning, experimentation, forecasting, segmentation, optimization, performance measurement, and decision modeling.
- Develop and evaluate models and decision frameworks that help teams understand business opportunities, assess tradeoffs, and make responsible, data-informed decisions.
- Create and enhance dashboards and visualizations using platforms such as PowerBI, Tableau, and conversational BI tools to communicate trends, metrics, and performance.
- Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations and communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams across data science, product, technology, data & analytics, privacy, governance, and regional and global partners
- Recommend improvements to analytical workflows, tools, and processes with a focus on scalability, reuse, automation, and long-term business value.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications



- Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data Science, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related STEM/quantitative field, graduating December 2027– August 2028 
-  Strong communications skills, specifically, the absence of repeated grammatical or typographical errors, clear and concise written and spoken communications that demonstrate professional judgment. 

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience in understanding and analyzing data using statistical software (e.g., Python, SAS, R, Stata or others).
- Experience with visualization and reporting tools, such as advanced user of PPT, Power BI, Tableau, open-source tools, or similar. 
- Exhibits intellectual curiosity and strives to continually learn. 
- Previous exposure to financial services, credit cards or merchant analytics is a plus, but not required.
- Experience with extracting and aggregating data from large data sets using SQL or other tools.
- Understanding of ML techniques.
- Competence in Excel, PowerPoint and Tableau.

Information for US Applicants

For roles located in the US, the estimated hourly rate is $46 to $55 USD. The hourly rate may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

Work Hours

Varies upon the needs of the department.

Travel Requirements

This position requires travel 5-10% of the time.

Mental/Physical Requirements

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

role: Co-Op, AI Nucleic Acid Design
jd:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is building scientific superintelligence by pairing large-scale automated experimentation with frontier machine learning. Within Lila, the Life Science AI (LSAI) function researches automated reasoning on biological data, combining state-of-the-art ML with breakthrough biology.

This co-op sits with the nucleic acid design group in LSAI, which builds models and design strategies for RNA and DNA sequences. You'll join our Nucleic Acid Design team for a 6-month co-op focused on open-ended research questions that could shape how Lila designs nucleic acid sequences in the future.

You'll work at the intersection of machine learning, sequence modeling and nucleic acid biology, on problems such as UTR design, regulatory element design, and using large reasoning models for scientific discovery. You'll own a defined research project with mentorship from ML scientists, and you'll work closely with experimental scientists to connect your models to real biological data.

The ideal candidate is curious, comfortable with open-ended problems, and excited to learn both the ML and biology behind sequence-to-function modeling.

What You'll Be Building



- Lead a scoped research project in nucleic acid sequence modeling or design.
- Build ML models on RNA and DNA sequence-function data, including prototyping new methods for property prediction, generative design or candidate selection.
- Investigate model behavior and propose biological hypotheses about why sequences succeed or fail.
- Explore how large reasoning models can drive scientific discovery and sequence design, for example by generating hypotheses, reasoning over experimental results or guiding design choices.
- Collaborate with experimental scientists to understand assays and to propose experiments that test new ideas.
- Present findings to the team and contribute to research write-ups, and where possible to external publications or presentations.

What You'll Need To Succeed



- Currently enrolled in an MS or PhD program in machine learning, computational biology, bioengineering, computer science, statistics or a related quantitative field.
- Hands-on experience building and training ML models, with strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, JAX or a similar framework.
- Coursework or research experience with biological sequence data (DNA or RNA).
- Curiosity about nucleic acid biology, such as RNA biology, gene regulation or sequence-to-function relationships.
- Available for a full-time, 6-month co-op term onsite in San Francisco.

Bonus Points For



- Experience with sequence-to-function models, genomic language models, or models trained on MPRA, reporter assay or other functional genomics data.
- Familiarity with RNA secondary structure prediction, UTR or codon design, or inverse design methods.
- Experience with generative modeling, active learning or Bayesian optimization.
- Exposure to wet-lab data or collaboration with experimental scientists.
- A research publication, preprint or open-source project in ML or computational biology.
- Experience using or building with large language or reasoning models, AI agents, or LLM-based tools for scientific tasks.

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

role: Visual Generation & Multimodal Evaluation Machine Learning Engineer Intern (AML-Ark-US) - 2027 Summer
jd:
Responsibilities

The Applied Machine Learning Ark team combines system engineering and machine learning to develop and operate Large Language Model (LLM) service platforms that offer businesses Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) solutions, serving both large model providers and downstream users. The US team drives the design, development, and operation of MaaS solutions across the US and international markets outside mainland China. We are building full-stack, end-to-end solutions spanning text and multimodal LLM algorithms, LLM training/fine-tuning/inference frameworks, prompt engineering, model alignment, and intelligent agent systems. Beyond model serving, we operate large-scale log analytics pipelines that process massive volumes of invocation logs from text models, multimodal models, and agent systems — extracting usage patterns, quality signals, and actionable insights to inform model improvement, system optimization, and product decisions through continuous, data-driven feedback loops. We are actively seeking talented engineers and researchers specializing in Large Language Models and AI Agent systems to join our dynamic team.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.

Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.

Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

-  Build evaluation systems for image and video models/agents, covering generation quality, instruction following, multimodal understanding, and safety.
-  Develop automated metrics and model-based evaluators, and design reproducible human evaluation protocols.
-  Design and develop video generation/debugging agents that orchestrate multi-step creative workflows.
